label:
Probiotic
milk drink
comment: Not yoghurt: one probiotic strain on its own, without the yoghurt cultures.

about.text: Milk fermented with a single strain of probiotic bacteria rather than with yoghurt cultures, such as acidophilus milk, made with Lactobacillus acidophilus, or Yakult, a small sweetened drink of skimmed milk fermented with Lactobacillus casei Shirota since 1935.
